items.headline: Google brings Gemini 4 Hydrogen to Search globally
items.summary: Google upgraded Search worldwide with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, enabling more intuitive, visual, and precise answers through simultaneous queries and structured results. The update intensifies the AI-powered search race against OpenAI and others.

items.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster Flash successor
items.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster and more capable but pricier successor to its Flash model line. It escalates the model competition against OpenAI's Luna, Meta's Ember, and Anthropic's Haiku.

items.headline: Gemini 4 Carbon now publicly available, undercuts rivals on price
items.summary: Google opened Gemini 4 Carbon to all developers, pricing it at a quarter of Claude Fable 5.2's rates while leading on some agentic benchmarks. The aggressive pricing escalates the frontier model price war.

items.headline: Gemini 4 Carbon frontier model opens to developers and scientists
items.summary: Google made its Gemini 4 Carbon frontier model available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers, touting state-of-the-art cybersecurity and agentic coding. It marks a major expansion of the Gemini 4 family.

items.headline: November Pixel Drop brings Gemini Intelligence to Pixel 10
items.summary: Google's November Pixel Drop introduced Gemini Intelligence to Pixel 10 devices alongside custom widgets and the new Pixel Tag. The update deepens on-device AI integration across Google's hardware lineup.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models
items.summary: Anthropic unveiled Fable 5.2 for coding and agents and restricted-access Mythos 5.2 for cybersecurity and life sciences, with Fable leading on 13 of 15 benchmarks and 20% lower API costs. It is the company's first frontier release since CEO Dario Amodei called to slow AI development.

items.headline: CodeRabbit ships 20x more software using OpenAI Codex
items.summary: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models and Codex to govern AI-generated code and ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team. The case study highlights the growing impact of agentic coding on developer productivity.

items.headline: OpenAI brings businesses into ChatGPT with new commerce features
items.summary: OpenAI launched tools letting businesses claim their presence and connect with customers directly inside ChatGPT. The move expands ChatGPT into a decision-making and commerce platform.

items.headline: Anthropic unveils two new models ahead of landmark IPO
items.summary: Anthropic's first frontier models since September's call to pace AI development went through rigorous safety testing and new post-launch monitoring tools. The releases position Claude competitively just weeks before the company's expected Wall Street debut.

items.headline: OpenAI releases Images 2.6 with faster, more controllable generation
items.summary: OpenAI launched Images 2.6, offering faster iteration, more editing control, GIF animation, and new API capabilities. The update strengthens OpenAI's position in AI image generation.
